artDirection: Original square object paintings; earthy pixel clusters to match the practice, structure and resource families. Reused at small size for relic icons; no external game art.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original square heirloom item artwork for a dark medieval civilization game, also readable as a tiny relic icon. Primary request: a thick aged bronze signet ring with an engraved sun crest. Style/medium: richly hand-placed low-resolution pixel clusters, crisp stepped contours, selective dithering, restricted 24-color palette like the supplied game's practice and structure art: charcoal, umber, warm stone, wheat, muted olive, restrained metallic accents. Composition: one large centred unmistakable object, fully visible, occupying 75% of a square canvas, three-quarter view, strong readable silhouette, minimal dark charcoal olive background and faint contact shadow. Light: warm directional amber light, deep earthy shadows. No people, no scenery, no text, no letters, no card frame, no border, no watermark. Avoid smooth gradients, photographic realism, plastic 3D rendering, cartoon outlines. Render square 1024 by 1024.
